predecessors.name: Livonian Confederation
predecessors.text: Harrien, Wierland and Reval, which asked for Swedish protection in June 1561, and Jerwen somewhat later

successors.name: Tsardom of Russia
successors.text: Estonia: the Estonian nobility and Reval capitulated on 29 September (O.S.) / 10 October (N.S.)

ledger.x: June 1561: northern Estonia places itself under Sweden.
1583: the Duchy of Estonia is created from the northern parts and Dagö, under Swedish control.
1602: Polish-Lithuanian forces fight in Swedish Estonia.
1611: a truce after the death of Charles IX ends the war; the infobox gives 'status quo ante bellum', so Swedish Estonia is unchanged.
1645: Wiek (Läänemaa) is counted in Swedish Estonia.

wars.name: Livonian War
wars.outcome: Sweden kept the lands that had sought its protection in 1561 and held Narva (retaken 1581); the Treaty of Plussa of 10 August 1583 left Narva and Ivangorod with Sweden and Russia gave up most of Ingria.

wars.name: Polish-Swedish War (1600-1611)
wars.outcome: Status quo ante bellum; Reval, Pernau and Narva remained Swedish through the war; truce 1611.

wars.name: Great Northern War
wars.outcome: The war on Estonian soil ended with the capitulation of Reval in September/October 1710; Russia was confirmed by the Peace of Nystad in 1721.

certainty.note: Drawn from county names, which only approximate the medieval Harrien, Wierland, Jerwen and Wiek; the page gives no boundary or area.
